description: A secondary/overflow hotel opening must not set the general hotel slot. Modeled on tails-of-summer, where the Overflow Hotel's opening was picked over the main room block's earlier one. Dates are TODAY-relative tokens so the edition never falls out of upcoming_events(); the post dates its opening with a weekday ("this Sunday") so the text stays coherent with the floating dates.

posts.text: Wow, our main hotel block filled up fast! Good news: we've secured an Overflow Hotel across the street. Overflow bookings open this Sunday at noon.

expect_absent.reason: this Sunday opens the overflow hotel, a qualified sub-instance — only the main room block sets hotel dates
